    Tuesday 6 October 2026

    Morning briefing

    Morning briefing

    The share column ships flat at the room's median - 10 names, 0 of them short, their order an unshipped shadow (R81) - and the option column ships the room's own G_OPTION median on 3 legs (R79), led by CSCO 2026-10-16 $120C at 55.0; watchdog sits suspended on a congressional feed that still serves no record count, and the board sat after the open

    Executive summary

    Mandate: Mix (any). Overnight: every Asian bar is stale (Nikkei 225 +2.40%, stale - last bar 2026-10-05; Hang Seng +0.28%; Shanghai Composite +0.31%, stale - last bar 2026-09-30; KOSPI +0.46%), Europe closed up (FTSE 100 +0.42%, DAX +0.77%, Euro Stoxx 50 +0.48%; +0.56% avg over 3) and the US futures read +0.68% (S&P 500) and +0.65% (Nasdaq 100), so Asia and the futures agree in sign, with the US 10-year yield at 5.26 (-0.92%) and the Dollar index at 101.84 (-0.32%) both easing. Expected shape: a straight session - this board SAT AFTER THE OPEN and froze in the afternoon with SPY +0.65 on the day against the futures' +0.68%, and I expect the close to hold that level rather than retrace it; SPY closing below its freeze mark 779.84 scores this expectation wrong. Regime: risk-on (SPY +2.0% 5d, VIX 15.07 falling, -2.9% on the day) but narrow, IWM -0.71 against QQQ +0.57, so this is a large-cap tape. The board's conviction is one macro bet, long AI-capex and power beta: AVGO, MRVL, MSFT, NVDA, AMZN, HPE and PLTR in the share column and CSCO's call in the option column are the same AI-infrastructure trade, GEV's shares with VST's call are its power leg, PANW's call is the security edge of it, and only NKE stands apart - 13 lines that are closer to one bet than to 13, and the spread across them controls variance, it does not add edge. What invalidates the book is one event: a risk-off turn in the index into the close, which takes every long down together; line by line, each kill is a close-only level at the served suggested_kill_level (CTVA, unshipped, at Chartist's support 11.92). No seat's calibration separates from zero (best grade_return_corr 0.027, blackswan, n 533; worst -0.199, sam), so nobody is reweighted and both columns ship the room's median; the chair-served neural net disagrees sharply on HPE (-7.5803) and NKE (-4.5479) inside the share column and on PTC (-14.3022) and CTVA (+39.7326) outside it, and it has no record that lets it author a departure. The pyramid leader is The Black Swan; its read diverges from the room on MRVL and PLTR (a share view of 42 on each against one-medians of 56 and 52, linear exposure fragile at 4.95%/d and 4.79%/d), on VST's call (40 against the gate's 55) and on MRNA's put (70), and it carries no extra weight (R33). Roster as served (R110): watchdog SUSPENDED; domestic_desk and decoder NON-FILING in the share column; decoder SHADOW (R27); the option roster was served as 14 members + 1 shadow + 0 non-filing + 1 suspended. The re-served labels over my shipped lines were not served to this seat. Horizon split across the 13 shipped leads: 3 intraday (AVGO, MRVL, HPE), 6 swing (the CSCO, VST and PANW calls; AMZN, NKE, PLTR) and 4 position (CAT, GEV, MSFT, NVDA); the aim of 8 swing is not reachable with three option legs worth shipping. R102: the room was served none of the open-claim contracts the desk dispatched. Of the dispatched ids, 4 sit on slate names - r66-run48-AMZN, r66-run48-AVGO, r66-run48-PLTR, r66-run49-HOOD - but each served contract on those rows is a different contract and no WINDFALL is recorded on any, so nothing was converted or vacated: AMZN, AVGO and PLTR ship as shares only (linear exposure beside the open calls, the same bet), HOOD ships in neither column, and the count of shipped option legs matching an open r66 row is 0. The option column is three legs, all on 2026-10-16 (R4 allows 4): every other contract sits under a room median of 50, could not sit in the top three under the +3.0% REQMOVE bar (MRVL at 4.727, MSFT at 3.695), carries a half-point median (PLTR 51.5), or is a pinned-name ticket with no edge (PTC at 50); ANET's call at 50 would repeat CSCO's networking bet. REQMOVE of the three: CSCO 2.284, VST 0.389, PANW 2.677. R92: my recompute re-reads the roster under R97 over the shipped option lines and moves three numbers - CSCO SERVED 53 / GATE 55 = (53+57)/2, VST SERVED 50 / GATE 55 = (50+60)/2, PANW SERVED 50 / GATE 52 = (50+54)/2 - and the shipped share lines re-read to the served one-medians. SHARE COLUMN=AVGO 56, MRVL 56, CAT 54.5, NKE 54.5, MSFT 54, GEV 53.5, NVDA 53.5, AMZN 53, HPE 52.5, PLTR 52 OPTION COLUMN=CSCO 55, VST 55, PANW 52 DIRSORT=[52 / none] - every line in the share column is a long, so there is no short grade to print. TAPE-CALL=longs over shorts on a risk-on large-cap tape: every share line is a long and every slate short (URI, MRNA, CIEN, LITE, PWR) files under 45 FALSIFIER=SPY closes below its freeze mark 779.84 KEY=indices.SPY.price HOUSE RULES, fixed before the freeze and not revisited mid-session. Stakes: the share column ships flat at 1.0 per line (R81) and the option legs at the desk's default option stake with no overrides; nothing sizes above default, and no line departs from the median. Exits: every lead dies only on a close through its stated level, executed at the next session's open, never on an intraday print; each option leg carries its EXIT token - the ratchet is its served break-even, and a close at or above it raises the kill to that level; kill close on the underlying; else close 2026-10-15 - and the premium a kill leaves at the served delta is not served. Windfall: a leg that marks at 2x its served premium or better banks half at the first mark the desk serves after it fires (R102) and trails the rest; no add, re-entry or re-strike on that name until the claim closes, and no name with an unexecuted WINDFALL ships in either column.
